scope: Enumerate both public matrix constructors at default precision over 36 × 36 storage types. Use three output rows, two columns, two reverse-selected experts for indexed products and width twice the least common multiple of operand block sizes. Query the stock CPU support report and vTensor before allocation. Ask the sole-provider stock scheduler to place each admitted graph.
cpu_kernel: Require a registered weight vector product and either its native activation type, an available F32-to-activation conversion, or the ordinary MUL_MAT widening path for F16/BF16 into F32. The indexed CPU widening branch accepts F32 input only. Reuse the 50 matching VT-170 CPU runs. All other marked paths ran the original CPU graph with quantized finite data and produced six finite outputs. The CPU support callback alone overreports executable types.
overflow_note: The two refused CPU paths also ran at widths 8 and 66 with BF16 activations of magnitude 131072.
